name: Unitree H2-X EDU
summary: The development version of the 1.73 m Unitree H2-X, with secondary development, a user compute module and a choice of dexterous hands.

germany.statusNote: Unitree shows "Contact Sales" with no price, and no German or EU seller was found. The shop.unitree.com front page, the RBTX humanoid category, the QUADRUPED Robotics H2 page, Generation Robots, MYBOTSHOP, Bipedal, Funduino and the Terra Robotics home page do not show it.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: 65+ kg with battery, varies by configuration

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: rated, about; peak about 15 kg; varies with scenario

specs.label: Operating time
specs.conditions: approx.; maker lists 8 h both static and walking, press reads the figure as standing endurance

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: PC1 8-core CPU, PC2 Intel Core i7 or Orin NX for user development; PC3 Thor T5000 or Orin AGX optional

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Wide-angle binocular head camera, wide-angle monocular chest camera, optional RGB-D chest camera, microphone array

notes: Dexterous hands: several models optional; the page does not say which, if any, comes as standard.
Maker says it is engineered for all-weather security work, but publishes no IP rating.
